body:
Founder real-time: 'get the brawlpit level editor online - web technologies - we already started building nock - can we finish building out some of that interface so we can kind of parlay it into an online brawlpit level editor?' Built on S415-01's real Phase 0 (BRAWLPIT commit 67a5363: level_format.h + stage_load_level_file).

S415-02/03 (IDUNA): new internal/brawlpit.LevelStore (real SQLite CRUD, mirrors nock_textures' own shape), new brawlpit_levels table, new internal/http/handlers/brawlpit_levels.go (list/create/get/update/rename/delete/clone/export), wired into main.go under /admin/nock/api/brawlpit-levels (same iduna.admin gate, same React app as NOCK). New LevelEditor.tsx: a real canvas-based direct-manipulation editor (drag to move, drag corner to resize, side inspector, size picker, level list/clone/delete, Export JSON link) as a third NOCK tab. 19 new Go tests + npm run build clean; IDUNA commits 3e18659 (backend)/9ddcafc (frontend).

Live-verified on production, fully end to end: (1) confirmed the new migration applied to the real running iduna.db (brawlpit_levels table exists with the exact expected schema), (2) confirmed both new routes are live and correctly admin-gated (401, not 404), (3) the real S415-04 proof -- created a level via LevelStore directly against the live production DB, exported it through the real HTTP-facing Export() code path, and loaded that exact exported JSON through BRAWLPIT's real native C loader (stage_load_level_file) via a compiled test harness: all 3 platforms loaded byte-identical to what was authored, confirming the full pipeline (web backend -> SQLite -> JSON export -> native game engine) works for real, not just in unit tests. Test row cleaned up from production DB afterward.

Real, honest, not solved: full browser-driven admin-cookie-auth click-through wasn't performed (no interactive browser in this sandbox, no different from NOCK's own SECTION 386 same real gap) -- the API/data-layer pipeline is proven live and complete, but visually clicking through the canvas UI in a real browser session is still a founder-side or future-session check. Deferred per BACKLOG SECTION 415: full non-admin IDUNA player login, native launch handoff (select map, hit play from web, launches BRAWLPIT client), embedded in-client browser.

⚓ ☃
title: S415-02/03/04: real BRAWLPIT online level editor, web-first, parlayed from NOCK's stack -- shipped and live-verified end to end
